row:
Hey it's Ruth! Here’s my little piece of the internet where I share my experience of working as a veterinary nurse.

But mostly this is a space to make you feel welcomed, happy and good about yourself. So, welcome!

I intend to upload every fortnight on Thursday evenings for now. Xx

DISCLAIMER:
Whilst I make every effort to broadcast correct information, I am still learning, and realise that veterinary medicine is a constantly changing science and art. Please consult your local veterinarian if you have any concerns for the health or welfare of an animal. These videos are not intended as medical advice. All views on this channel are my own and do not represent my current or previous employers. Any footage of animals are from strays (at the time) being cared for in the clinic, wildlife, personal pets, or those from clients where consent has been obtained.
